title: lightly flamed thai yogurt spoon-food
description: a comforting and lightly sweetened thai-style spoon-food dessert featuring flamed coconut milk and rich full-fat yogurt, perfect for warm weather or as a soothing treat after a meal.

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.notes: or other sweet spice of choice

instructions: in a small saucepan, melt the butter or heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
add the chili flakes and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
add the honey, cinnamon, cardamom, and palm sugar to the saucepan, and stir to combine.
continue to simmer for 2-3 minutes or until the mixture has thickened to your liking.
stir in the full-fat yogurt until well combined and heated through.
remove from heat and let cool slightly.
to flambé, carefully ignite the coconut milk mixture with a lighter or match, and let burn for 10-15 seconds or until slightly charred.
immediately cover the saucepan to extinguish the flames.
serve warm, garnished with desiccated coconut and fresh mint leaves if desired.
adjust sweetness and spice level to taste.
